title: Labefaction
summary: LABEFAC'TION, noun [Latin labefactio, from labefacio, labo, to totter, and facio, to make.] A weakening or loosening; a failing; decay; downfall; ruin.

inlines.v: LABEFAC'TION, noun [Latin labefactio, from labefacio, labo, to totter, and facio, to make.] A weakening or loosening; a failing; decay; downfall; ruin.
